text: She drove away the cold, icy winds and the thousand nights, and rose up in the next. Before the separated pair of swans, crying out to each other, stood Kripavati. With her mouth, fragrant as a lotus, she, as if adorning the waters with a garland of lotuses, made the frost-fallen, shattered lotuses appear as if they were a collection of lotuses, while she was about to part her lips at night.
